evals.prompt: How do I enable dark mode in my Kigumi React project? I want a toggle switch that persists the user's preference.
evals.expected_output: Code using .wa-dark class on html element, localStorage persistence, prefers-color-scheme detection. Should NOT use .dark class.
expectations: Mentions prefers-color-scheme media query for system preference detection
Does not use any fabricated token names like --wa-color-brand-hover or --wa-color-background

evals.prompt: I want to make all border radius values larger across my whole Kigumi app. Like everything should be more rounded. What's the easiest way?
evals.expected_output: Should recommend --wa-border-radius-scale token override at :root, not individual radius tokens.
expectations: Explains that scale multiplies all S/M/L radius values
Does not use fabricated tokens like --wa-border-radius-small or --wa-border-radius-medium

evals.prompt: How do I customize the look of a specific Button component in my Kigumi project? I want to change its background and add uppercase text.
evals.expected_output: Should use ::part(base) CSS selector, not fabricated --wa-button-* tokens.
expectations: Does NOT recommend --wa-button-background or --wa-button-* tokens (these don't exist)
Shows valid CSS properties like text-transform, background-color
May reference the cascade layers (wa-theme-overrides) for proper specificity

evals.prompt: Show me all the color tokens available for theming in Kigumi. I need to understand the color system.
evals.expected_output: Lists real WA color tokens: surface, text, variant (brand/success/warning/danger/neutral fill/border/on), utility colors.
expectations: Explains the variant color system (brand/success/warning/danger/neutral x fill/border/on x quiet/normal/loud)
Does NOT list fabricated tokens like --wa-color-background, --wa-color-text-secondary, --wa-color-border
